'''Orlando Smith''' is a natural historian found on the basement floor of the [[Varrock Museum]]. He runs the [[Natural history quiz]] there, in which he asks players to go around and look at the plaques on all of the museum exhibits, testing their knowledge of the creatures of [[Gielinor]]. He will reward players who finish the quiz with museum [[kudos]] and 1,000 [[Slayer]] and [[Hunter]] [[experience]]. Once a player has 153 kudos, they may speak to him to complete a step in the [[Hard Varrock Diary]].
